text:
lia (marketing): Hey runtime team — quick ask for launch materials. We need a small vetted samplepack + clear retention rules for the benchmark artifacts used in the marketing claims. Can you confirm which sample file we should point to and whether you can rerun with the quantized variants?

raj (eng-runtime): Yep. Which claim/slide is this for? coldstart or steady-state numbers?

lia (marketing): Coldstart 95th pct and a small warmup vs throughput slide. We want: original FP32, q4_0, and q8_0 (if available). Also need the exact command used so we can reproduce the numbers in PR notes.

mike (eng-runtime): Understood. We have a canonical payload set: payloads/marketing/launch_cohort_v1.jsonl. It contains 150 queries (mix short prompts + some long context). We can run the three variants.

lia (marketing): Perfect. Two more things: 1) retention — marketing needs raw outputs + perf logs for 90 days in the artifacts bucket, and 2) a small manifest listing seed, env, and runner version. Is 90 days OK?

raj (eng-runtime): 90 days is fine. We keep full run artifacts for 30 days by default, but we can stage-mark these and extend to 90 in s3://redwood-archives/marketing/launch-2026/. We'll add a manifest file.

mike (eng-runtime): I'll schedule reruns. Acceptance checklist for marketing: artifacts include (a) outputs JSONL, (b) per-request latency CSV, (c) runner stdout log, (d) manifest.json with {runner_version, git_sha, seed, model_variant, quant}. Also include warmup profile.

lia (marketing): Nice. Can you paste the exact CLI you’ll run so docs can copy it into the press kit?

mike (eng-runtime): Paste below — will attach exact artifact paths after runs.

```
# run example
./bench-run \
  --model redwood-v2  \
  --variant base,quant_q4_0,quant_q8_0 \
  --payloads payloads/marketing/launch_cohort_v1.jsonl \
  --seed 42 \
  --concurrency 8 \
  --warmup 20 \
  --out-dir s3://redwood-archives/marketing/launch-2026/mark_v1/ \
  --log-level info
```

raj (eng-runtime): Note: for q8_0 we may not have an approved kernel on some SKU; if that happens we'll include auto-fallback to q4_0 and record it in manifest. Also we'll include the topology (GPU type) in the manifest.

erica (marketing): Great — can you also include a short README in that folder that lists which exact slide each file maps to? Makes it easier for reviewers.

mike (eng-runtime): Will do. ETA on runs: ~3 hours from now. I'll ping when artifacts are uploaded.

runtime-ci-bot: [info] bench-run job queued (id: br-2026-09).

lia (marketing): Awesome, thanks. When you ping, can you also attach a tiny sample (5 entries) we can put in the public repo for reproducibility? :pray_emphasis:

mike (eng-runtime): Yep — will include samples/marketing/launch_cohort_v1_preview.jsonl (5 items) and a md README with repro steps.

lia (marketing): Perfect. That should cover legal + press. Appreciate it! :thumbsup:
